rows = feed.get('results')

output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'returned_count': len(rows), 'reported_total': report['reported_total']}))
